description: Explicit baseline shard renames, splits, or removals. Replacement keys must upload successfully before an old key is excused.

changes.reason: Two changes shrank the VisionLanguage conformance set from 173 to 166 models. #2269 removed four duplicate document models (Donut, LayoutLMv3, Nougat and Pix2Struct under src/VisionLanguage/Document; the document implementations elsewhere remain). #2136 moved EmuEdit, MGIE and SmartEdit onto LatentDiffusionModelBase, and diffusion models do not implement IShapeContract (the diffusion test bases check them instead). Offset 165 now ends the set (1 candidate) and the offset 170 window selects none.
